records.title: Spiral converge / word / center-out / ease-in-out / center

operation.name: Spiral converge
operation.mechanism: Make two turns around the destination while the orbit radius shrinks to zero. Keep glyph orientation upright unless a secondary rotation is declared.

channels.interpolation: selected temporal response; feed into the stated movement equation

operation.channel_interpretation: rig.progress is the selected temporal response v, not an interpolated transform or baked mesh trajectory. Evaluate movement_equation to obtain the actual channel values; use clamped s where specified.

grouping.description: Group whitespace-delimited orthographic tokens while retaining all spaces and punctuation. These tokens are not guaranteed semantic words in every language.

activation.description: Activate nearest to the center of the ordinal unit sequence first, then outward; break ties by original index. This is ordinal, not geometric center.

composition.description: Center the measured text block around canvas anchor (.5,.5). Keep the original reading order and derive actual widths and wraps from font metrics.

coordinates.canvas: Normalized anchors [0,1], origin top-left, x right, y down; final glyph positions require actual font metrics. Local offsets use nominal em, not a claim of measured cap height.
coordinates.world: Right-handed, x right, y up, z toward camera; 1wu = 1 nominal em; adapt units and axis signs explicitly.

timeline_template.local_progress: u=clamp((frame-start_i)/enterFrames,0,1); v=selected temporal curve(u); apply the family equation to v, using s=clamp(v,0,1) wherever specified.
timeline_template.delays: start_i=activation_rank_i*staggerFrames; nominal stagger=round(.055*fps), at least one frame. Refit or split the scene if the resulting timing is too long.
timeline_template.reading_rule: Global read hold begins after the last unit reaches its final read pose. Extend for text complexity, audience and real voice cues; two seconds is an editable starting point, not a reading-speed standard.
timeline_template.temporal_definition: Symmetric acceleration and deceleration; curve v=u*u*(3-2*u). Finish entrance before beginning the reading interval.
timeline_template.phase_note: For a shot-scope operator use one shared rig; unit traversal controls visibility/accent only. Portal transit is an exit action after reading.

records.read_pose: Exact shaped text at its measured target; stable geometry, intended color, no residual entrance offsets. Essential content remains readable throughout the read interval.
records.exit: Fade the complete unit from opacity 1 to 0 over the selected exit duration; preserve its text, baseline and geometry until hidden.

conditions.layout: Resolve actual font shaping, line breaks, measured bounds and safe insets before rendering. Layout anchors are initial suggestions, not fitted typography.
conditions.degeneracy: Different IDs can yield identical motion on one unit, short text or zero amplitude. Conditional metadata/assets must be supplied or an explicitly labeled fallback selected.

mix_and_customize.family_specific: Replace the circular orbit with an ellipse or change turn count; finish at exactly the same measured target.
mix_and_customize.construction: Keep a primary action; add independent channels or stage actions sequentially. Declare transform hierarchy, channel ownership, shared camera scope, phase boundaries and final neutral/rest values. For conflicting channels choose override/add/multiply deliberately.
mix_and_customize.extension: You may define new paths, deformations, relations or scene topology beyond this catalog; record parent IDs, equations, parameters, seed, constraints and semantic reason.

fallbacks.reduced: Remove camera travel, oscillation and deformation; use a brief fade or cut with the same text and sufficient stable reading time.
fallbacks.static: Show complete exact text in the fitted final layout, retaining labels, values, units and qualifiers.

content_invariants: Preserve exact text, spaces and punctuation.
Keep grapheme combining marks with their base.
Do not fabricate intermediate prices, percentages or claims.
Keep negation and qualifiers readable with their associated statement.

lineage.kind: original authored composition; cited sources support underlying techniques, not this exact preset

scene_3d.representation: flat text-bearing plane/surface; no glyph side volume

scene_3d.lighting: Initial key/fill/rim relative intensities 1/.35/.5; key at (4,6,7), fill(-4,2,6), rim(0,3,-3)wu. These are authored starting values; adjust contrast and material response.
scene_3d.material: Initial base #F4EEE2, roughness .4, metallic .15, opacity1; verify actual renderer color/energy behavior.
scene_3d.geometry_checks: Preserve shaping, diacritics and counters; verify bevel clearance, normals, UVs, clipping and backfaces. A camera-facing plane is not solid glyph geometry.

operation.movement_equation: depth=0.005+(0.16-0.005)*clamp(v,0,1) em; bevel starts at 0.015 em only if topology permits; front-face z stays fixed.
